This page shows an exercise and its solution.

## Goals

::: {.objectives title="After this page, you can"}

- Do an exercise.
- Open a solution and compare it with your work.

:::

## The task

::: {.exercise title="Add a page" duration="10 min"}

Make a file `notes.qmd`.
Give the file a title and one paragraph of text.

:::

::: {.solution title="Solution"}

Write this in `notes.qmd`.

```{.markdown filename="notes.qmd"}
---
title: "Notes"
---

My first note.
```

:::
